title: Outstanding team
text: I would like to write review on my recent stay at Intercontinental Barclay: Outstanding team   My great experience started from reservation. When I needed to change my reservation, it was too late for me to change online myself. Then I called and spoke to Aanira. She was patient and professional to hear my explanation and request and quickly made the adjustment. The front desk and IHG member service reps were responsive and helpful. The lounge team members, Silvia, Paulette, and John, were warm and smiling, and always greeted me. They made it feel like home. Thank you all."
author: Pioneer30426696055
